question: M, N, O, P, Q, R and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only four people sit between Q and R when counted from the right of Q. Q sits third to the left of X. P sits third to the left of M. N is an immediate neighbour of R and X. How many people sit between O and N when counted from the right of O?
solution:
Given:

M, N, O, P, Q, R and X are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Only four people sit between Q and R when counted from the right of Q.

Q sits third to the left of X. P sits third to the left of M. N is an immediate neighbour of R and X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/915bf095d04ad0704195f043abad1633f3bcd3a4fab734ea7a171bdac7382421.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4abe826a6679582d72ee3753ea676ed8cea6cc291871ce6a77928e1025447ae.png] 

Thus, 2 people sit between O and N when counted from the right of O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
